notes: OpenAI released GPT-Live 1.1 on 2026-11-19 (Live API, v1/live/sessions); it improves pronunciation, accent consistency and transcription in multilingual voice conversations. The $0.05 per minute price covers the Live voice-session layer and is billed per second without rounding up to a whole minute. Backend model and tool usage are billed separately. From 2026-11-19 OpenAI also lists a lower Standby rate of $0.02 per minute for WebRTC sessions while inference is paused; Standby is not modeled as a separate processing mode or charge. Null token-price fields mean not applicable, not free.
